name: Koi Shite Aniken
source:
There's talk in the art club of a high school.
The art club animation study group (abbreviated Aniken) starts a self-produced animation and targets the grand prize in the cultural festival exhibition!
The Aniken is filled with members of rich individuality.
Although they have the will the individual Aniken members are completely lost on what to do with both animation production and love.
Can you stick to this animation until it's completed?
Could this be the future of a romance?

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.operahouse.aniken&feature=nav_result#?t=W251bGwsMSwyLDNd]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
高中美术社里流传着一个话题。动画研究组（简称Aniken）开始制作自制动画，目标是在文化祭展览中夺得大奖！

Aniken成员个性丰富，虽然有意愿，却完全不知道如何兼顾动画制作与恋爱。你能坚持到动画完成吗？这会成为恋爱的未来吗？
